title: Prod → Dev D1 sanitization / data-classification contract
referential_notes: EXCLUDE member_sessions and login_attempts removes auth continuity; Dev uses fixture members only.
REPLACE WITH FIXTURE members must use synthetic emails referenced by any remaining member-linked Dev rows.
EXCLUDE join_email_log; join_requests may remain as transformed rows without matching email log.
content_items rows with non-public privacy_flag are excluded; dependents should tolerate missing parents or be filtered.
photos.people is COPY AS-IS per PD-3358-01.

product_decisions.question: May memorabilia people tags copy as-is into Dev, or must they be redacted/randomized?
Confirm REPLACE WITH FIXTURE (synthetic members only) vs TRANSFORM of Production membership roster.

go_hold_recommendation.reason: PD-3358-01 closed as COPY AS-IS. PD-3358-02 remains proposed fixture-only members default (not a blocking hold). Auth/PII fail-closed rules remain enforced by the manifest.
